import FreeCAD

# Open and check the document
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

sketch = doc.getObject("PentagonSketch")

# Check if the sketch forms a closed loop
# The last geometry's end point should match the first geometry's start point
first_geom = sketch.Geometry[0]
last_geom = sketch.Geometry[-1]

print(f"First geometry start: ({first_geom.StartPoint.x}, {first_geom.StartPoint.y})")
print(f"Last geometry end: ({last_geom.EndPoint.x}, {last_geom.EndPoint.y})")

# They should be equal for a closed polygon
if abs(first_geom.StartPoint.x - last_geom.EndPoint.x) < 0.0001 and abs(first_geom.StartPoint.y - last_geom.EndPoint.y) < 0.0001:
    print("\n✓ Sketch is properly CLOSED (last point connects to first)")
else:
    print("\n✗ Sketch is NOT closed!")

# Verify all connections are valid
print("\nChecking all vertex connections:")
for i in range(len(sketch.Geometry)):
    curr = sketch.Geometry[i]
    next_idx = (i + 1) % len(sketch.Geometry)
    next_geom = sketch.Geometry[next_idx]
    
    # Current edge ends where next edge starts
    curr_end = (curr.EndPoint.x, curr.EndPoint.y)
    next_start = (next_geom.StartPoint.x, next_geom.StartPoint.y)
    
    if abs(curr_end[0] - next_start[0]) < 0.0001 and abs(curr_end[1] - next_start[1]) < 0.0001:
        print(f"  Edge {i} -> Edge {next_idx}: OK")
    else:
        print(f"  Edge {i} -> Edge {next_idx}: MISMATCH!")

print("\nDocument saved successfully at /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
